comments.author: constroyr
comments.body: Here's a quick demo of Jazz vs Waffles, an AI-Powered party game where you can battle any characters you can imagine. We're currently running a public test of it at [https://www.jazzvswaffles.com/](https://www.jazzvswaffles.com/) if anyone is interested. I would love any feedback from my fellow AI game devs.

replies.author: JedahVoulThur
replies.body: I tried Athenea vs Hitler and Athenea vs Jesus but none of them loaded. It returned to the main screen with a red text on top saying "Good job, you broke it. Game restarted". Could the cause be that I tried running it from an Android phone?

replies.author: constroyr
replies.body: Ah man, thanks for trying it. Strange. We just tried it on android with those characters and it was working for us. I wonder if the service was just briefly down while you tried it.

replies.author: JedahVoulThur
replies.body:
It could also be a connection issue. I'll try later from a wifi connection and tell you how it goes.
It seems a fun game, congratulations

replies.body: Hey, I tried Eleanor Shellstrop vs Joseph Stalin but like the other person it just went back to the start saying I broke it.

replies.author: MikePounce
replies.body: The music plays upon winning even when turned off in the settings

comments.author: SharksEatMeat
comments.body: Wild!  Really fun turn based ai battles.  The prompts worked well and the move-sets playfully matched the characters.  As did the dialogue.  Fun and impressive.

comments.author: Fl333r
comments.body:
Very cool! You might be onton something. It is missing a je ne sais quoi. Stakes? Perhaps that's the only thing missing but IDK. 

There are also issues with consistent character generation and some of the quips sound like it has a very surface level understanding of the character. Another instance I tried Constantinople VS Ravenna and it generated Ravenna the Sorceress instead of the city. Small issues but maybe you can live with it.

I am curious about how you are generating the characters images though or which API is responsible for that.
